## 📋 Repository Changes

This PR updates repository configurations via `repositories.json`.

### 🔍 Review Checklist

- [ ] JSON syntax is valid
- [ ] Operation is correct (create/import/update/delete)
- [ ] Repository names follow conventions
- [ ] Visibility is appropriate (public/private)
- [ ] Teams are assigned correctly
- [ ] No accidental deletions
- [ ] Branch protection settings are as intended

### 📝 Terraform Plan

See the **Terraform Plan Summary** comment below for what will change.

Run `/plan` in comments to re-validate before merging.

### ✅ How to Merge

1. Review the plan in comments
2. Approve this PR
3. Merge to `main`
4. Workflow will automatically apply changes

No manual terraform commands needed.

### ⚠️ Destructive Operations

If this PR includes `delete` operations, extra care is needed.

Deletes are permanent. Review carefully before merging.
